releases.notes:
## Venomous 7.18.8

Highlights across **7.18.5 – 7.18.8**. Full details in `CHANGELOG.md`.

### Fixed

- **The quit hang.** Clicking Quit froze the client for twenty seconds and ended in a
  `ClientShutdownWatchdog` crash report (exit -8). Baritone's cache workers are non-daemon
  threads parked in a loop that swallows interrupts and `Throwable`, so nothing could release
  them; a shutdown reaper now forces a clean exit the moment `main()` returns.
- **Scaffold rotation grid** (7.18.4). The staged pitch is snapped onto the verified 26.2
  sensitivity grid (`f³ × 1.2` per mouse count, checked against `MouseHandler.turnPlayer` and
  `Entity.turn` bytecode) at both staging sites, so Grim's `RotationPlace` no longer sees steps
  no mouse could produce.

### New modules

- **rod-aimbot** (combat) — right click with an uncast rod is intercepted and the cast is staged
  against where the target will be, with both rotation axes grid-snapped. The camera is never
  taken.
- **fake-lag** (network) — delays outbound packets, inbound packets, or both, with hard flushes
  on teleport, damage and disconnect; keep-alives and chunk traffic always pass.
- **lag-range** (network) — the same hold, engaged only while closing on a target inside the
  reach band, flushed the moment the exchange changes shape.
- **backtrack** (network) — holds one target's movement packets while the withheld position is
  the better one to swing at, decided by a pure ray/box reach-band table.
- **no-slow** (movement) — overrides 26.2's data-driven using-item slowdown at its single
  client seam, with per-item filters and vanilla parity as the default.
- **keep-sprint** (combat) — captures the motion going into your swing and restores it after
  vanilla's 0.6 penalty, sprint re-raised.

### Removed

- Fourteen dead modules: twelve 1.8-era packet relics (`more-carry`, `bungeecord-spoof`, `kick`,
  `portal-exploits`, `reset-vl`, `sleep-walker`, `chorus-exploit`, `v-click-tp`,
  `vehicle-one-hit`, `v-ghost-hand`, `time-shift`, `v-anti-hunger`) plus three the repo's own
  audit proved wired to nothing (`text-field-protect`, `extended-firework`, `v-ghost-hand`).

Every port states its deviations and its anticheat cost honestly — see `CHANGELOG.md`.

Venomous 7.0.1

Experimental release for Minecraft 26.2, Meteor Client 26.2, Fabric, and Java 25.

Highlights:
- Reworked Scaffold and bridging profiles
- Moved gameplay actions away from post-tick execution
- Restored clean compilation with explicit setting builders
- Improved Aimbot and AntiProjectile input ownership
- Removed the Dupe module
- Simplified project documentation

This remains a work-in-progress release. Test only where you have permission.
